'''Hela Apparel Holdings PLC''' branded as '''Hela Clothing''' is a [[holding company]] in [[Sri Lanka]] that is engaged in the apparel industry. The company supplies to a number of brands such as [[Tommy Hilfiger]], [[Calvin Klein]], and [[Michael Kors]]. Hela Apparel Holdings operates four design centres in Sri Lanka, the United States, France and the United Kingdom. The company have eleven manufacturing plants, seven in Sri Lanka, and two each in Ethiopia and Kenya.<ref>{{cite web |title=Hela Apparel Holdings Ltd |url=https://markets.ft.com/data/equities/tearsheet/profile?s=HELA-N-0000:CSE |website=[[ft.com]] |publisher=Financial Times |access-date=25 June 2022}}</ref> The company is one constituent of the [[S&P Sri Lanka 20 Index]] since June 2022.<ref>{{cite news |title=CSE: Constituent changes in S&P SL 20 Index |url=https://archives1.sundayobserver.lk/2022/06/19/business/cse-constituent-changes-sp-sl-20-index |access-date=25 June 2022 |work=[[Sunday Observer (Sri Lanka)|Sunday Observer]] |publisher=[[Associated Newspapers of Ceylon Limited]] |date=19 June 2022}}</ref>

==History==
Hela Clothing (Pvt) Ltd was incorporated in 1991.<ref>{{cite news |title=Hela Clothing heralds more growth with Egypt entry |url=https://www.ft.lk/top-story/Hela-Clothing-heralds-more-growth-with-Egypt-entry/26-723097 |access-date=25 June 2022 |work=[[Daily FT]] |publisher=[[Wijeya Newspapers]] |date=15 September 2021}}</ref> The Fielding Group was the initial owner of the company. British entrepreneur [[Dominic McVey]] invested in Hela Clothing in 2013. Sri Lankan business executive Dian Gomes was hired by McVey to lead the company. By 2017, the company was incurring sizeable overheads and facing [[cash flow]] constraints. The company was forced to expand into Ethiopia and Kenya. Gomes wanted to raise capital by either infusing capital from existing shareholders or diluting 30% of ownership to raise US$10 million from outside investors. Gomes's relationship with McVey was strained when Gomes wanted to suspend the annual management fee of US$1 million to the investment firm Ellestone Apparel, a company headed by McVey. In 2019, Gomes resigned from the company and  McVey divested significantly his stake. An investor consortium infused US$10 million into the company's capital in November 2018.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Daniel |first1=Devan |title=What happened at Hela |url=https://www.echelon.lk/what-happened-at-hela/ |access-date=25 June 2022 |work=echolon.lk |publisher=Echelon Media (Pvt) Ltd. |date=24 May 2019}}</ref> 

Hela Clothing appointed A. R. Rasiah as the new chairman of the company in December 2018.<ref>{{cite news |title=Hela Clothing appoints new chairman |url=https://www.pressreader.com/sri-lanka/sunday-times-sri-lanka/20181202/282729112964549 |access-date=25 June 2022 |work=[[The Sunday Times (Sri Lanka)|The Sunday Times]] |publisher=Wijeya Newspapers |date=2 Dec 2018 |via= [[PressReader]]}}</ref> Hela Apparel Holdings (Pvt) Ltd was founded in 2018 and was listed on the [[Colombo Stock Exchange]] in 2022 through an [[initial public offering]] (IPO). The IPO was intended to offer 20% of the stake of the company and raise the capital of LKR4 billion. The IPO was the largest issue since 2011.<ref>{{cite news |title=Hela Apparel IPO – decade's biggest – snapped up on opening day |url=https://www.ft.lk/front-page/Hela-Apparel-IPO-decade-s-biggest-snapped-up-on-opening-day/44-729121 |access-date=25 June 2022 |work=Daily FT |publisher=Wijeya Newspapers |date=13 January 2022}}</ref> The IPO was [[Subscription (finance)|oversubscribed]] 5.4 times and received applications worth LKR21.8 billion.<ref>{{cite news |title=Hela Apparel Holdings Rs. 4 b IPO sets new milestones, oversubscribed by 5.4 times |url=https://www.ft.lk/front-page/Hela-Apparel-Holdings-Rs-4-b-IPO-sets-new-milestones-oversubscribed-by-5-4-times/44-729717 |access-date=25 June 2022 |work=Daily FT |publisher=Wijeya Newspapers |date=27 January 2022}}</ref>

==Operations==
The company received a [[credit rating]] of AA(lka) from [[Fitch Ratings]] in March 2022 and the outlook is adjudged as stable.<ref>{{cite web |title=Hela Apparel Holdings (Pvt) Ltd |url=https://www.fitchratings.com/entity/hela-apparel-holdings-pvt-ltd-97326784 |website=fitchratings.com |publisher=Fitch Ratings |access-date=25 June 2022}}</ref> Hela Apparel Holdings expanded into Egypt by launching its twelfth plant in the country. Egypt was chosen due to the advantages of being located proximately to Europe and North America, thus reducing shipping times.<ref>{{cite news |title=Hela Apparel Holdings formally starts operations in Egypt |url=https://www.ft.lk/front-page/Hela-Apparel-Holdings-formally-starts-operations-in-Egypt/44-730915 |access-date=25 June 2022 |work=Daily FT |publisher=Wijeya Newspapers |date=22 February 2022}}</ref> The company recorded a 75% revenue growth in the financial year 2021/22. The revenue for the period was LKR56 billion.<ref>{{cite news |title=Hela Apparel Holdings completes landmark year of growth and consolidation |url=https://island.lk/hela-apparel-holdings-completes-landmark-year-of-growth-and-consolidation/ |access-date=25 June 2022 |work=[[The Island (Sri Lanka)|The Island]] |publisher=[[Upali Newspapers]] |date=28 May 2022}}</ref> In 2022, the company has been awarded the [[ISO 14064]]-1:2018
certification by the Sustainable Future Group. The certification was awarded to Hela Apparel Holdings for establishing a framework to report and quantify greenhouse gas emissions. It also involves implementing a Carbon Management Plan for reducing emissions.<ref>{{cite news |title=Hela Apparel Holdings receives ISO 14064-1:2018 certification |url=https://ceylontoday.lk/2022/05/21/hela-apparel-holdings-receives-iso-14064-12018-certification/ |access-date=25 June 2022 |work=[[Ceylon Today]] |publisher=Ceylon Newspapers (Private) Limited |date=21 May 2022}}</ref>
